pizarro.definition: n. Spanish conquistador who conquered the Incas in what is now Peru and founded the city of Lima (1475-1541)
pizarro.translation: n. (Pizarro)人名；(西、葡)皮萨罗；(俄)皮扎罗

pizazz.translation: n. 精力, 魅力, 华丽

pizazzy.translation: a. 有精力的;潇洒的;绝色的

pizz.translation: abbr. pizzicato (Italian=plucking strings by the fingers) （意大利语）拨奏（曲）

pizza.definition: n. Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese

pizza face.translation: [网络] 长满豆豆的脸；长满青春痘的脸

pizza parlor.translation: [网络] 必胜客；比萨馆；披萨店

pizza pie.translation: [网络] 披萨派；比萨拍；一整块比萨

pizza shop.translation: [网络] 披萨店；比萨饼店；转让

pizzas.definition: n. Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
pizzas.translation: n. 意大利薄饼, 比萨饼( pizza的复数形式 )

pizzazz.definition: n the activeness of an energetic personality
pizzazz.translation: n. 精力, 劲儿, 精神, 漂亮, 时髦派头

pizzeria.definition: n. a shop where pizzas are made and sold
pizzeria.translation: n. 匹萨饼店, 意大利肉饼店

pizzerias.definition:
plural of pizzeria
n. a shop where pizzas are made and sold
pizzerias.translation: (pizzeria 的复数) n. 匹萨饼店, 意大利肉饼店

pizzicato.definition:
n. a note or passage that is played pizzicato
s. (of instruments in the violin family) to be plucked with the finger
r. with a light plucking staccato sound
pizzicato.translation:
n. 拨奏曲, 用指弹的乐曲
a. 指弹的

pizzle.definition: n. The penis; -- so called in some animals, as the bull.
pizzle.translation: 动物的阴茎(过去曾做鞭子用)
